title: Population Simulator with Causal Loop Diagram
description: A graphic novel about Tragedy of the Commons.
subject: Mathematics
topic: Population Simulator with Causal Loop Diagram
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the variables, arrows, and polarity markers that form the reinforcing loop in the causal loop diagram
Explain why a positive link from population back to births produces exponential rather than linear growth
Predict the population at t=30 for birth rates of 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, and 0.10 before running the simulation
Analyze how moving the birth rate slider changes the steepness and doubling time of the growth curve
Distinguish reinforcing loops from balancing loops using loop structure and R or B notation
